This figure contains two side-by-side line plots, labeled **А** (left) and **Б** (right), both sharing the same x-axis structure.

**Plot А** illustrates the change in average laying period measured in days ("Средни леглодни (дни)") over time ("Години"). The x-axis displays years at irregularly spaced intervals: 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021, on a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "Средни леглодни (дни)" and ranges from approximately 200 to 280, with gridlines or tick marks at intervals of 20 units. A single red solid line with black circular markers connects the data points across the five years. The line begins at approximately 278 days in 2008, decreases slightly to about 266 days in 2012, rises to approximately 270 days in 2013, then declines more steeply to around 240 days in 2017, and continues declining to approximately 196 days in 2021.

**Plot Б** shows the structural effect on average laying periods expressed as a percentage ("Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)") over the same years ("Години"). The x-axis displays the same year labels: 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021. The y-axis ranges from approximately 0.5 to 2.5%, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 percentage points. A single red solid line with black circular markers connects the data points. The line starts at approximately 1.5% in 2008, decreases to about 0.8% in 2012, drops further to approximately 0.6% in 2013, then increases to around 1.2% in 2017, and rises sharply to approximately 2.7% in 2021.
